author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.75 shipped: Paused rooms stop occupancy lights and fans
summary: Paused rooms stop occupancy lights and fans
why: Operator ruling 2026-10-18: paused rooms must not have lights or fans automated on occupancy (the zone vacancy sweep was turning off lights in paused rooms). Operator confirmed 2026-10-19 that HVAC-side fans including sleep-onset stop too and that a paused room may still be marked vacant for zone retreat. Three reviews, clean name-diff, mutation-verified gates.
implications: Shipped ROOM-OVERRIDE-SWITCH-FORGOTTEN-1 at v5.103.75; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.75.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Revisit if a paused fan room holds its zone occupied for hours (Media/GB1/GB2 lack a fan-immune witness) or if the operator wants an unpause catch-up.

refs.release_notes: Paused rooms (Automation off or Manual Mode) no longer get occupancy-driven lights or fans: zone sweep, HVAC comfort/sleep-onset/pre-arrival fans, fan recheck and exit retry are gated. Safety stop, turn-off-all and recheck restore still run.
